page.notes: Column headers and entry order follow the printed index. Several figures in the middle and right columns are small and uncertain; I have copied them as best I can read them. Printed "f" for long s has been written as s throughout. The word "mendacium" is broken across two lines in the printing without a visible hyphen, so it is written whole. The line "Saulis invidium ingenium" is read from the scan with some doubt. Only the catchword "Saulis" is printed below the final line.
